hook_line: if(!MG.armed&&(location.hash.includes('mg')||(SIM.sleep_no===0&&SIM.npcs.filter(x=>x.tribe===-1&&!x.burn).length>=8))){MG.armed=true;}if(MG.armed&&!MG.active&&!SIM.terminal&&SIM.sleep_no===0&&!transitioning){MG.active=true;MG.state=mgInit();transitioning=true;this.nightAlpha=0.4;this.drawWorld();if(!MG.shown_tip){MG.shown_tip=true;this.tut.pending_teaching='mg_first';TEACHING_TEXT.mg_first='You tend the flame, and those who approach will stay only if it neither wavers nor burns.';}}if(MG.active){const clicked=this.input.activePointer.isDown&&this.input.activePointer.leftButtonDown()&&this.input.activePointer.getDuration()<100;MG.state=mgStep(MG.state,clicked);mgOverlay(this,MG.state);if(MG.state.outcome){const[eff,n]=mgResolve(MG.state);if(eff==='convert_devout'){for(let i=0;i<n&&SIM.npcs.some(x=>x.tribe===-1);i++){const g=SIM.npcs.find(x=>x.tribe===-1);g.v=8;g.ever_nonzero=true;}}else if(eff==='burnout'){for(let i=0;i<n&&SIM.npcs.some(x=>!x.burn&&x.tribe!==-1);i++){const t=SIM.npcs.find(x=>!x.burn&&x.tribe!==-1);t.burn=true;}}else if(eff==='drift_apathy'){for(let i=0;i<n&&SIM.npcs.some(x=>x.v!==0);i++){const a=SIM.npcs.find(x=>x.v!==0);a.v=0;}}this.time.delayedCall(2000,()=>{MG.active=false;transitioning=false;this.nightAlpha=0;this.drawWorld();});}}
notes: The encounter arms on sleep 0 if 8+ grey nomads exist (or if hash contains 'mg' for Director testing). When armed and not already active, it pauses the sim, dims the world to 40%, initializes the flame at mid-brightness with 8 nomads in a ring at distance 12. Each frame, left-click brightens the flame; it decays naturally. Nomads commit and approach when flame is in the drifting steady band, recoil/die if too bright or too dim. Win: all alive nomads reach distance <=2.5 with commit >=0.9 (converts 3 grey to devout). Flare: all nomads dead and flame >0.7 (burns out 2 NPCs). Dim: all nomads dead and flame <=0.7 (drifts 1 NPC to apathy). The first_use_line is injected into TEACHING_TEXT under key 'mg_first' and displayed via pending_teaching on first trigger at sleep 0.
